title: Noor and the Group Chat
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Wren Ishikawa, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
